name: Able Warrior
text: When you declare an **Advance** action, you may immediately spend 2 fatigue to make 2 attacks this turn instead of 1.

name: Battle Cry
text: When you declare a **Battle** action, you may immediately restore 1 fatigue to yourself and all adjacent heroes.

name: Bear Tattoo
text:
You have the **Grapple** ability.

In addition, your maximum number of wounds is increased by 2.

name: Berserker
text:
You gain +2 Damage to all of your attacks whenever you have lost half or more of your wounds.

This bonus increases to +4 Damage whenever you have one quarter of your wounds or fewer remaining.

(Note that this skill works differently from the "Berserk" special ability.)

name: Brawler
text:
When you make a **Melee** attack, you gain +1 Damage for each monster adjacent to you beyond the first one.

In addition, each time you use a **Melee** attack to deal the killing blow to an enemy figure, you inflict 1 wound (ignoring armor) to all enemy figures adjacent to it. If the figure is **Undying**, this effect does not happen unless the figure stays dead.

name: Brawny
text:
When you place a prolonged action order to make a prolonged **Melee** action, you roll twice instead of once to accumulate progress tokens (maximum 5 power dice each roll).

You may open doors for 0 movement, but if you do so, the door is destroyed. You must still have a runekey to open rune-locked doors.

name: Captain
text:
Exhaust this skill at the start of the overlord's turn to allow every hero that doesn't already have a placed order (including yourself) to place their choice of a dodge, rest, or aim order.

This skill only refreshes when you (and only you) activate a glyph.

name: Cleaving
text: Each time you kill an enemy with a **Melee** attack, you may spend 1 fatigue to immediately make 1 additional attack with the same weapon. You may do this once each time you kill an enemy with a **Melee** attack.

name: Counter Attack
text: After an enemy figure in your melee range rolls a miss result, you may immediately make 1 **Melee** attack against that figure. You may do this once each time an enemy figure in your melee range rolls a miss result.

name: Defender
text:
If you have a ***Shield*** equipped, you may exhaust it to cancel wounds being dealt to you ***or*** 1 adjacent hero. The number of wounds canceled still equals the amount listed on the ***Shield*** card.

In addition, while you have a guard order placed on you, all other adjacent heroes gain **+1 armor**.

name: Die Hard
text: Each time you (and only you) activate a glyph, you heal yourself for 8 wounds.

name: Enduring
text: **Armor** does not reduce your speed. In addition, if you are not wearing **Armor**, you gain **+1 Armor**.

name: Furr the Spirit Wolf
text:
**Familiar**

Furr the Spirit Wolf is your familiar. Take the Furr marker at the start of the game.

name: Knight
text: When you declare a **Battle** action, you may immediately spend 2 fatigue to gain movement points equal to half your speed (round up) and may make 3 attacks instead of 2 this turn.

name: Leadership
text:
When you declare a **Ready** action, you may immediately spend 1 fatigue to take 3 half actions instead of 2 half actions (one half action must still be an **order** half action).

In addition, when you place an order, you may allow another hero to place the order instead.

name: Mighty
text: When making a **Melee** attack, you gain +2 Damage.

name: Nimble
text:
Your maximum fatigue is increased by 1.

In addition, it never costs you more than 1 movement point to enter a space.

(Other costs and effects to enter a space are not affected.)

name: Ox Tattoo
text: You are immune to **Daze**, **Grapple**, **Knockback**, **Stun**, and **Web**.

name: Parry
text: You gain **+1 armor** against **melee** attacks per campaign level (+2 at Silver, +3 at Gold).

name: Relentless
text: When you declare an **Advance** action, you may immediately recover 1 fatigue.

name: Runner
text: When you declare a **Run** action, you may immediately spend 1 fatigue to make 1 attack, instead of none.

name: Shark Tattoo
text:
Your maximum wounds are increased by 2.

In addition, you gain the **Swim** ability.

name: Swashbuckler
text: When you declare a **Battle** action, you may immediately spend 2 fatigue to gain movement points equal to half your speed (round up) and place a dodge order on yourself at the end of your turn.

name: Taunt
text: When an enemy figure within 5 spaces of you declares an attack, but before dice are rolled, you may force the figure to target you with that attack if it is able to do so.

name: Tiger Tattoo
text:
Your speed is increased by 1. Any speed reduction from **Armor** is applied before this bonus.

Your maximum fatigue is increased by 1.

In addition, you take no damage from falling into pits or from pit **Trap** cards.

name: Tough
text: Your maximum wounds are increased by 4.

name: Unmovable
text: When you declare a **Battle** action, you may place a **guard** order during your turn and you gain **+1 Armor** until the start of your next turn.

name: Weapon Mastery
text: When making a **Melee** attack, you gain 2 free surges.

name: Acrobat
text: You may move through enemy figures. In addition, you may enter and move through obstacles (but not other props, such as scything blades or boulders) without effect. You may not end your movement or make an attack from a space occupied by either another figure or an obstacle that blocks movement.

name: Alertness
text: When an enemy figure moves into a space adjacent to you, you may spend 2 fatigue to immediately make 1 attack against that figure. You may do this once each time an enemy figure moves into an adjacent space.

name: Ambidextrous
text: When you receive an **Off-Hand Bonus**, your attack gains +1 Damage. In addition, each time you use a ***Shield***, it cancels 1 additional wound.

name: Appraiser
text: When you draw 1 or more treasure cards, draw 1 extra treasure card, then choose 1 and return it to the bottom of the deck, facedown.

name: Born to the Bow
text: All ranged attacks that you make using two-handed weapons are **aimed attacks**.

name: Burglar
text:
It only costs you 1 movement point to open or close a door, or to open a chest.

In addition, ***Trap*** cards played by the Overlord in response to an action you have taken cost him 1 extra threat.

name: Cautious
text: The overlord receives 1 fewer threat token each turn. In addition, ***Trap*** cards always deal 1 less wound to you (minimum 0).

name: Crack Shot
text: When making a **Ranged** or **Magic** attack, you may trace line of sight from any empty space that is adjacent to you.

name: Dead Eye
text: Your **Ranged** attacks gain **+2 damage** and cannot be dodged.

name: Eagle Eye
text:
When making a **Ranged** attack, you gain **Pierce 2**.

In addition, when making a **Ranged** or **Magic** attack you gain +1 Range.

name: Evasion
text:
**Ranged** and **Magic** attacks suffer a –3 penalty to **range** when targeting you.

Attacks that target more than one space ignore this ability.

name: Gunner
text:
All attacks you make with cannons gain **+1 range** and **+1 damage**, and are automatically aimed.

If not playing the ***Sea of Blood*** advanced campaign, discard this skill and draw again.

name: Keen Sight
text:
When making **Ranged** or **Magic** attacks, you gain **+1 range** and **+1 damage**.

In addition, your attacks ignore the **Shadowcloak** ability.

name: Lightfinger
text: Lightfinger is your familiar. Take the Lightfinger marker at the start of the game.

name: Lucky
text: Any time you roll a power enhancement on a power die during an attack roll, you gain **both** +1 Range **and** +1 Damage to the roll instead of having to choose one or the other.

name: Marksman
text: When making a **Ranged** or **Magic** attack, you gain +3 Range.

name: Master Archer
text: When making a **Ranged** attack, you gain 2 free surges.

name: Pickpocket
text:
When you deal the killing blow to a normal unnamed monster, you gain 25 coins.

When you deal the killing blow to a master monster, you gain 75 coins instead of 50 coins.

name: Piercing Shot
text:
Exhaust this skill before making a **Ranged** attack to make that attack an aimed attack and give it **Pierce 10**.

This skill only refreshes when you (and only you) activate a glyph.

name: Precision
text: You may ignore 1 figure or obstacle when tracing line of sight for a **Ranged** or **Magic** attack.

name: Ranger
text:
When you place a prolonged action order to make a prolonged **Ranged** action, you roll twice instead of once to accumulate progress tokens (maximum 5 power dice each roll).

All **Ranged** attacks you make using one-handed weapons gain +1 Damage. All **Ranged** attacks you make using two-handed weapons gain +2 Damage.

name: Rapid Fire
text: After making a **Ranged** attack, you may immediately spend 2 fatigue to make 1 additional attack with the same weapon this turn. You may use this ability multiple times, paying its cost each time.

name: Shadow Soul
text:
**Familiar**

The Shadow Soul is your familiar. Take the Shadow Soul marker at the start of the game.

name: Skilled
text: Your maximum fatigue is increased by 2.

name: Spry
text:
Your maximum fatigue is increased by 1.

In addition, your speed is increased by 1. Any speed reduction from **Armor** is applied before this bonus.

name: Swift
text: Your speed is increased by 2. Any speed reduction from **Armor** is applied before this bonus.

name: Trickster
text:
Exhaust this skill before an enemy figure makes an attack against you that only targets 1 space. That attack is redirected against another figure (friendly or enemy) of your choice. If the redirected attack is unable to hit its new target (due to range, etc.) then it automatically misses.

This skill only refreshes when you (and only you) activate a glyph.

name: Alchemist
text: Each time you (and only you) activate a glyph, you gain 3 potions of your choice.

name: Alex the Wise
text: Alex the Wise is your familiar. Take the Alex the Wise marker at the start of the game.

name: Bardic Lore
text:
When you place a prolonged action order to make a prolonged **Magic** action, you roll twice instead of once to accumulate progress tokens (maximum 5 power dice each roll).

Whenever a chest is opened, you draw all of the treasure cards and distribute them equally to the heroes as you see fit.

name: Blessing
text: You have the **Command** ability.

name: Boggs the Rat
text:
**Familiar**

Boggs the rat is your familiar. Take the Boggs the rat marker at the start of the game.

name: Brin's Mark
text:
During your turn, you may sacrifice 1 wound to place a dodge, aim, or rest order on yourself. You may do this up to 2 times per turn, but you may never have more than one order placed at a time.

Losing these wounds cannot be prevented by any means.

name: Divine Retribution
text: When you are killed by an enemy figure, all **unnamed** enemy figures within 3 spaces of you are immediately killed as well. This ability ignores the **Undying** ability.

name: Draggy
text:
Draggy is your familiar. Take this token at the start of the game.

Once per turn, Draggy may attack a monster by breathing fire on her enemies. This attack is made with 1 White Die. Draggy is considered to be flapping above her keeper and may not be targeted by any attack. The token may be kept near the player's hero card.

name: Earth Pact
text:
You may move through rubble obstacles without effect. You must end your movement in an empty space and you may not attack while in the same space as a rubble obstacle.

In addition, if you do not move during your turn, you recover 2 wounds at the end of your turn.

name: Fire Pact
text:
You may move through lava obstacles without effect.

In addition, you are immune to **Burn**.

Finally, when attacking with a "Staff," you gain the **Burn** ability.

name: Hand of Death
text:
Exhaust this skill instead of making an attack to target a normal unnamed monster in an adjacent space. Roll a power die. On anything but a surge, that monster is instantly killed. On a surge, you suffer 2 wounds (ignoring armor).

This skill only refreshes when you (and only you) activate a glyph.

name: Holy Aura
text: You have the **Aura** ability.

name: Inner Fire
text: When making a **Ranged** or **Magic** attack, you gain +2 Range and +1 Damage.

name: Ran's Mark
text:
During your turn, you may sacrifice 1 wound to heal all other friendly figures within 3 spaces of you (regardless of line of sight) by 1 wound. You may do this up to 2 times per turn.

Losing these wounds cannot be prevented by any means.

name: Koll's Mark
text:
During your turn, you may sacrifice 2 wounds to make 1 additional **Magic** attack. You may do this up to 2 times per turn.

Losing these wounds cannot be prevented by any means.

name: Mage Cloak
text: You gain **+1 armor** for each ***Rune*** you have equipped, up to a maximum of +3.

name: Mata and Kata
text:
**Familiar**

Mata and Kata are your familiars. Take the Mata and Kata markers at the start of the game.

name: Necromancy
text: You have the **Necromancy** ability.

name: Prodigy
text: When making a **Magic** attack, you gain 2 free surges.

name: Quick Casting
text: After making a **Magic** attack, you may immediately spend 2 fatigue and exhaust this card to make 1 additional attack with the same weapon this turn.

name: Saj's Mark
text:
After rolling a **Magic** or **Ranged** attack, you may sacrifice 1 wound to add 2 surges to the attack. You may do this up to 2 times per attack.

Losing these wounds cannot be prevented by any means.

name: Sharr the Brightwing
text:
**Familiar**

Sharr the Brightwing is your familiar. Take the Sharr marker at the start of the game.

name: Spiritwalker
text: When making a **Magic** attack, you may cause the attack to originate from any space up to 10 spaces away that contains a friendly figure (but not a familiar). All aspects of the attack (such as tracing line of sight and calculating range) are done as though you were in that space.

name: Telekinesis
text: Spend 1 fatigue during your turn to move any figure within your line of sight 1 space, following normal movement rules. You may use this ability multiple times, paying its cost each time.

name: Vampiric Blood
text: You gain 1 fatigue each time you deal the killing blow to an enemy figure. If the figure is **Undying**, you do not gain fatigue unless the figure stays dead.

name: Water Pact
text:
You may move through water obstacles without effect. You must end your movement in an empty space, and you may not attack while in the same space as a water obstacle.

In addition, when attacking with a "Staff," you gain the **Knockback** ability.

name: Wild Talent
text:
You have the **Sorcery 1** ability.

In addition, you always roll 1 extra power die when rolling power dice to avoid or reduce the effects of ***Trap*** cards.

name: Willpower
text: You gain **+1 armor** against **magic** attacks per campaign level (+2 at Silver, +3 at Gold).

name: Wind Pact
text:
You may move through pit obstacles without effect.

In addition, when a new area is revealed, you may immediately look at the overlord's hand and force him to discard 1 card of your choice. He receives threat for the card that you force him to discard.
